# Quantum-group symmetry of the imaginary-coupling theories {#sec-qg-symmetry}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Construct the non-local conserved charges of imaginary-coupling affine Toda theory.
- Show that they generate $U_q(\hat g^\vee)$ and compute $q$ in terms of $\beta$.
- Fix the gradation from the Lorentz spins of the charges.
- Conclude that soliton S-matrices are R-matrices times scalar factors.
:::
